heroHeadline: Explosive Drone Found in Romanian Field as EU States Summon Russian Envoys Over Leipzig Attack
heroSubtitle: A resident in Vaslui County, Romania discovered an explosive-laden drone in a field roughly 30 km from the Moldovan border on September 1; the Romanian Intelligence Service's counter-terrorism unit safely detonated it hours later with no casualties. The find came as Romania joined France, Belgium, Portugal, the Netherlands and the EU in summoning Russian ambassadors over Germany's formal attribution of the Leipzig/Halle Airport drone attack to Russia, with interim Foreign Minister Oana Ţoiu vowing 'there will be no impunity.' It follows Polish F-16 intercepts of Russian Il-20 reconnaissance flights near Łeba (Aug 31) and Ustka (Sep 3) and an overnight drone alert on the Estonia-Latvia border (Sep 1).
